m_client_Transport.name: Transport
m_client_Transport.summary: Transport 是直连与 relay 共用的字节通道。HTTPClient 仅供网关原样搬运。

m_client_ExecutionClient.name: ExecutionClient
m_client_ExecutionClient.signature:
type ExecutionClient interface {
	Dispatch(ctx context.Context, opts DispatchOpts) (*proto.Task, error)
	Reply(ctx context.Context, taskID, ticketID, answer string) error
	Continue(ctx context.Context, taskID, instructions string) error
	Stop(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (worktreeRemoved bool, err error)
	WaitEvent(ctx context.Context, taskID string, all bool) (*proto.Event, error)
	FollowEvents(ctx context.Context, taskID string, all bool, idle time.Duration, onEvent func(*proto.Event) error, onBacklog func(*BacklogSummary) error) error
}

m_client_Client.name: Client
m_client_Client.summary: Client 是 agentd 的 HTTP/WS 客户端，持有服务地址与 Bearer 令牌。 并发安全：baseURL/token/hc 与 WS 节奏字段构造后只读；游标根由 cursorRootOnce 保护，首次调用解析、后续读缓存，可被多个 goroutine 同时使用。

n_client_isDeliverable.name: isDeliverable
n_client_isDeliverable.summary: isDeliverable 是 WaitDeliveryPolicy 的包内别名。既有 wait/follow/backlog 调用点未迁；策略归属见 WaitDeliveryPolicy（应用，不在传输）。

n_client_NewRelay.name: NewRelay
n_client_NewRelay.summary: NewRelay 创建 relay-backed client，并标记后续传输失败为 ErrTunnelDisconnected。

n_client_Client_MarkForwarded.name: Client.MarkForwarded
n_client_Client_MarkForwarded.summary: MarkForwarded 返回带防环头的副本，并保留 relay 传输失败分类。

n_client_Client_NoRedirect.name: Client.NoRedirect
n_client_Client_NoRedirect.summary: NoRedirect 返回禁用重定向且保留 relay 传输失败分类的副本。

n_client_Client_do.name: Client.do
n_client_Client_do.signature: func (c *Client) do(ctx context.Context, method, path string, body any) (*http.Response, error)
n_client_Client_do.summary: do 单次发送带 Bearer token 的请求；relay 非上下文传输失败包装为 ErrTunnelDisconnected，直连包装为 ErrUnreachable。

n_agentd_Server_forwardJSON.name: Server.forwardJSON
n_agentd_Server_forwardJSON.signature: func (s *Server) forwardJSON(r *http.Request, name string, c *client.Client, token string, body []byte) (status int, headers http.Header, payload []byte, err error)
n_agentd_Server_forwardJSON.returns: status int, headers http.Header, payload []byte, err error
n_agentd_Server_forwardJSON.summary: forwardJSON 经目标机客户端发一次有大小上限的 JSON 请求，把完整响应交回调用方。 成功/失败分叉留给调用方：失败原样透传；成功由 handler 挂卡再写响应。本函数不写账本。

n_agentd_Server_forwardWorktreeIfRequest.name: Server.forwardWorktreeIfRequested
n_agentd_Server_forwardWorktreeIfRequest.signature: func (s *Server) forwardWorktreeIfRequested(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (handled bool, ws *proto.Workspace, cardIDs []string)
n_agentd_Server_forwardWorktreeIfRequest.summary: forwardWorktreeIfRequested 是建树请求专用的 ?machine 转发路径。 返回： - handled=false：不是跨机请求，调用方走本机建树 - handled=true 且 ws==nil：已向 w 写入拒绝或目标错误，调用方必须直接 return - handled=true 且 ws!=nil：目标建树成功。本函数不写账本、不写成功响应； copyForwardHeaders 已落到 w。调用方用 cardIDs 挂卡后再 writeJSON。 为什么建树不能走通用的 forwardIfRequested：card_ids 指的是协调者本机账本里的卡。
